dev.mote.units: Lengths are dp; colours are #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB (alpha first, Compose Color(0xAARRGGBB)). Gradients run top->bottom unless an angle is given. Layers are painted in array order (index 0 = bottom).
dev.mote.colorFormat: tokens.json #AARRGGBB maps to srgb components + alpha; hex keeps #RRGGBBAA
dev.mote.dimensionUnit: tokens.json dp is exported as px (1 dp = 1 CSS px at the artboard scale)

notMapped.textures: grain and brushed noise are procedural bitmaps (generation recipes), not tokens: see tokens.json textures
notMapped.materials: layered recipes (shadow, gradient, texture, innerLine, strokeGradient) are composition rules: see tokens.json materials
notMapped.components: per-component geometry (sizes, ring radii, hit sectors) and prose: see tokens.json components
notMapped.parity: CSS vs Compose notes: see tokens.json parity
notMapped.gradientGeometry: DTCG gradients carry stops only; angle/centre/radius are in each token $extensions["dev.mote"]
notMapped.shadowAlpha: shadow alphaMul and layer comments are in $extensions["dev.mote"]; DTCG shadow colour aliases cannot carry an alpha multiplier
